description: Get US federal per diem rates (government travel lodging and meal allowances) for a location by zip code. Returns the monthly lodging ceiling (per-diem lodging varies by month/season) and the flat M&IE (meals & incidental expenses) daily rate. Example: rates_by_zip({ zip: "80202" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

year.description: Fiscal/rate year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

name: rates_by_zip
